title: FFmpeg drawgraph wrapper with ffprobe range check
purpose: Wraps the signalstats+drawgraph command from art_01M6WKQRQ6EZX1MWKZ4H6AF7MM r1 with an ffprobe pre-pass that prints the actual observed YAVG min/max from the clip, giving a numeric baseline to confirm the graph min= and max= parameters are correctly set before rendering.
